voice: Ornament on purpose. Jewelled nouns, classical names, flowers and gold, a sonnet's turn in the middle, a paradox stated as if it were obvious. Beauty is the subject even when the subject is prison. Keep the diction high and the feeling sincere; the wit lives in the arrangement, never in a joke.
